name: Wild Goats and Sheep
description: Wild goats and sheep are hoofed Mammals of the bovid family, built for life on steep, rocky ground.$(br2)They have stocky bodies, short sturdy legs and hooves with soft, grippy pads, and both sexes usually carry horns. Rival males settle disputes by clashing horns, sometimes for hours.$(br2)They live in mountains, cliffs and rugged uplands, where their agility keeps them safe from most predators.
